utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Monday the twenty-eighth. Everyone on? Bit of an echo from somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's probably me. There, headset in. I was going to ask about weekend plans, then remembered it's Monday. Mine were a washout anyway, with that weather.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same. Put the washing out, brought the washing in. Full itinerary.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Better entertainment than the football last night. Ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You say that every Monday, though.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, just connected. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. More time sitting there than actually driving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You're here now. Right, let's separate what's finished from what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I signed off the inspection on the relief valve on Tuesday. That's done, not something still on my list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, closed item.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the fire alarm panel on Tuesday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so the inspection isn't still outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, inspection signed off. Just clearing that up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, we already swapped the filter on the turbine one gas valve yesterday. Don't carry that forward as another job.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Old line, not new work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel tomorrow at 9:30? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel tomorrow at 9:30. First priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that stays at the top because of the production hold, rather than just sitting with the routine stuff?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Needs doing first, and the sign-off is tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: While we're on plant status, I saw the pressure on the stretch wrapper dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Just an observation, I'm not putting a job against it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing from me: heard a slight rattle from the forklifts. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations. Neither's a new task out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the GT1. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the blocker. Can't do much with an empty space where the parts should be.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Blocked, not available work for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. What else have we got on the safety side?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon. Not an emergency but don't let it slip — that's where I'd put it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah Price. Monthly fire alarm test with you this afternoon, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do it. Routine, but it isn't getting pushed out.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you — that's separate from the inspection you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Tuesday's inspection is finished; this is the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you also update the risk assessment for work on the Palletiser? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Palletiser. Normal priority, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Have you put a deadline against that, or just the priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just normal priority. No deadline set for that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, got it. Separate entry from the alarm test.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the near miss at the palletiser — that's a separate write-up as well, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. We need someone to write up the near miss at the palletiser after lunch. It matters but it's not urgent. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, I'm not volunteering for that as well. My yes was for the risk assessment.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I was only asking which bit of paperwork we meant. I'm not taking the write-up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No taker, then. That's still unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, it needs doing after lunch, but nobody owns it. Let's be clear about that rather than pretend it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. A quiet Teams call doesn't count as someone saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. Davey, can you send the shift handover report round next Tuesday, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round next Tuesday. Spare-minute job, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Next Tuesday for that one, not bundled into this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, next Tuesday. If you've got a spare minute — not something to bump the priority work for.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine by me. I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: More useful reading than the match report, anyway.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Low bar, mate. Very low bar.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, quick read-back of what we've actually agreed, then we're done.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Mine's the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel, tomorrow at 9:30. Needs doing first because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon — not an emergency, but no slipping it. And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Palletiser at normal priority, no deadline set.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round next Tuesday, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the near miss at the palletiser write-up is needed after lunch, matters but isn't urgent, and still has nobody against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. That's an open need, not an accepted task for anyone here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing assigned out of the forklifts rattle either. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And GT1 stays blocked on parts. No work agreed on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that's clear. Thanks, everyone. We'll leave it there.
